items.title: 68728_Jonah
items.q: we got Osie Johnson in Art's place

ctx.x: Was that when you said you were saying to him, "Don't play all that modern stuff?"

Well, what he was doing, he was trying to play like Monk and them, see, I think. And we asked 'what do you want to do?' And then after -- see, the thing was Art Blakey left and Harold left, because they was two good friends. That was the tenor player. They left, so we got Aaron Sachs in his place and we got Osie Johnson in Art's place. Now, Osie knows something about them chords you know, so he would have Earl's fingers bending way over there, and he'd say, "See, that's it." He's showing Earl, and Earl, he's…
